credentials.name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
credentials.type: Professional certification
credentials.about: Validates foundational knowledge of AI, machine learning, generative AI concepts, and AWS AI service use cases.

price.notes: AWS lists USD 100; INR voucher pricing may be available through its authorized voucher store.

credentials.usefulness: A good entry credential for AI concepts on AWS, but not proof of advanced model-building skills.
credentials.prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; basic familiarity with AI/ML concepts is helpful.
credentials.exam_details: 65 questions; 90 minutes; multiple choice/multiple response.
credentials.research_notes: Official AWS page lists exam fee, format, and intended candidate profile.

credentials.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate (MLA-C02 beta)
credentials.type: Professional certification — beta exam
credentials.about: Validates implementation, deployment, and maintenance of AI/ML workloads on AWS, with the updated blueprint expanding into foundation models, LLMs, agentic workflows, and responsible AI.

price.notes: USD 75 beta price for MLA-C02; the standard updated exam is expected in early 2027. Verify availability before booking.

credentials.usefulness: Strong role match for production ML and cloud AI engineering. As of October 2026, the updated exam is in beta, so check the exam status before planning.
credentials.prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS recommends hands-on experience with SageMaker AI, Bedrock, and ML engineering services.
credentials.exam_details: MLA-C02 beta: 85 questions; 170 minutes; English; Pearson VUE test centre or online proctoring.
credentials.validity: Check official page for validity details for the current exam version.
credentials.research_notes: Official AWS announcement dated July 14, 2026 says English beta registration opened September 1 and beta delivery began September 29, 2026.

credentials.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional
credentials.type: Professional certification
credentials.about: Validates advanced skills for integrating foundation models into applications and workflows, building production-grade GenAI, using RAG/vector stores, testing, safety, security, optimization, and operations.

price.notes: AWS lists USD 300; regional pricing may apply.

credentials.usefulness: High relevance for production GenAI, RAG, and AI application engineering on AWS; better after substantial hands-on experience.
credentials.prerequisites: Target candidate: 2+ years building production applications and 1+ year implementing generative AI solutions; AWS compute, storage, networking, security, and deployment knowledge recommended.
credentials.exam_details: 75 questions; 180 minutes; multiple choice/multiple response.
credentials.research_notes: Official AWS certification page and exam guide.

credentials.name: Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer
credentials.type: Professional certification
credentials.about: Validates building, evaluating, productionizing, deploying, monitoring, and optimizing ML models and AI solutions on Google Cloud, including newer GenAI capabilities.

price.notes: USD 200 plus applicable tax.

credentials.usefulness: A strong cloud ML credential for production ML, MLOps-aware ML engineering, and AI architecture. Recommended for people with practical GCP experience.
credentials.prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; Google recommends 3+ years industry experience, including 1+ year designing/managing solutions on Google Cloud.
credentials.exam_details: Professional exam; check the current official exam guide for format and updated GenAI scope.
credentials.research_notes: Official Google Cloud exam guide says the updated exam covering GenAI and Vertex AI Agent Builder launches October 1, 2026.

credentials.name: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
credentials.type: Professional certification — business/strategy focused
credentials.about: Assesses GenAI fundamentals, Google Cloud GenAI offerings, output-improvement techniques, and business strategies for successful GenAI solutions.

price.notes: USD 99 plus applicable tax.

credentials.usefulness: Useful for AI strategy and architecture conversations, but less technical than ML Engineer or GenAI Developer credentials.
credentials.prerequisites: No prerequisites; intended for people in technical or nontechnical roles.
credentials.exam_details: 50–60 multiple-choice questions; 90 minutes; online or onsite proctored.
credentials.research_notes: Official Google Cloud page lists exam cost, format, and validity.

credentials.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI-103)
credentials.type: Professional certification
credentials.about: Validates development of AI applications and agents using Azure AI services; relevant to building and integrating AI-powered apps and agent workflows.

price.notes: Typical Microsoft role-based exam price in the US; country/region price is shown during booking.

credentials.usefulness: Useful for Azure-based AI application and agent development. Confirm the live exam page and current study guide before purchasing.
credentials.prerequisites: Practical programming and familiarity with Azure AI services, APIs, and agent/application development are recommended.
credentials.exam_details: Exam AI-103; consult the current official study guide for skills measured and exam format.
credentials.validity: Microsoft role-based certifications generally require annual renewal; online renewal assessment is free.
credentials.research_notes: Microsoft lists AI-103 as the Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate credential; the older AI-102 credential retired June 30, 2026.

credentials.name: Microsoft Certified: Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI-300)
credentials.type: Professional certification
credentials.about: Validates operationalizing machine learning and generative AI solutions, including AI/ML operations, fine-tuning data, model lifecycle, deployment, monitoring, and production management on Azure.

price.notes: Typical Microsoft role-based exam price in the US; verify regional price during booking.

credentials.usefulness: A good fit for operationalizing models and production AI; more MLOps-oriented than research-oriented.
credentials.prerequisites: Hands-on Azure ML/AI service experience and software/data lifecycle knowledge recommended.
credentials.exam_details: Exam AI-300; official study guide covers operationalizing ML and GenAI solutions. Check current exam booking page.
credentials.validity: Microsoft role-based certifications generally require annual renewal; online renewal assessment is free.
credentials.research_notes: Official Microsoft Learn study guide is active in 2026; do not confuse it with retired AI-102 or DP-100.

credentials.name: Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate
credentials.type: Professional certification
credentials.about: Validates designing and deploying RAG applications and LLM chains using Databricks tooling, including Vector Search, Model Serving, MLflow, and Unity Catalog.

price.notes: Price may vary by country, taxes, or checkout.

credentials.usefulness: Strong targeted credential for RAG and enterprise GenAI application engineering in the Databricks ecosystem.
credentials.prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; Databricks recommends training and around six months hands-on experience.
credentials.exam_details: 45 questions; 90 minutes; online proctored.
credentials.research_notes: Official Databricks exam guide lists fee, format, and validity.

credentials.name: NVIDIA Certified Associate: AI Model and Application Development (NCA-AMAD)
credentials.type: Professional certification
credentials.about: Validates foundational AI model and application development, including model selection, prompt engineering/fine-tuning concepts, inference, deployment, and application integration.

price.notes: Price may vary by country, taxes, or checkout.

credentials.usefulness: Useful entry-level vendor credential for AI developers building and deploying model-powered applications.
credentials.prerequisites: Foundational AI development knowledge and preparation through NVIDIA's recommended learning path.
credentials.exam_details: 50–60 multiple-choice questions plus hands-on lab; 1 hour.
credentials.research_notes: Official NVIDIA certification page lists price, format, and validity.

credentials.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
credentials.type: Course-based professional certificate — not a proctored vendor certification
credentials.about: Multi-course program covering machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, and practical AI projects.

price.notes: Coursera subscription price varies by country and offer; financial aid may be available. Audit access may not include the certificate.

credentials.usefulness: Structured foundation for ML and AI engineering; stronger when the capstone and projects are published in a portfolio.
credentials.prerequisites: Working knowledge of Python and Jupyter notebooks is helpful; beginner-oriented.
credentials.exam_details: Course quizzes, hands-on assignments, and capstone; no single proctored certification exam.
credentials.research_notes: IBM's official training page describes the course series and project-based learning.

credentials.name: IBM Generative AI Engineering Professional Certificate
credentials.type: Course-based professional certificate — not a proctored vendor certification
credentials.about: Course series on generative AI, transformer concepts, prompt engineering, LLM applications, deployment, and hands-on GenAI projects.

price.notes: Coursera pricing varies by country and promotion; verify whether certificate access is included.

credentials.usefulness: Relevant for learners building GenAI skills; projects and working demos matter more than the certificate alone.
credentials.prerequisites: Beginner-friendly; Python and Jupyter knowledge helps.
credentials.exam_details: Course assessments and hands-on projects; not a single proctored certification exam.
credentials.research_notes: IBM official training information identifies this as a Coursera professional certificate.

credentials.name: IBM RAG and Agentic AI Professional Certificate
credentials.type: Course-based professional certificate — not a proctored vendor certification
credentials.about: Hands-on learning in RAG, vector databases, multimodal GenAI, tool calling, and agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and BeeAI.

price.notes: Coursera pricing varies by country and promotion.

credentials.usefulness: Very relevant to RAG and agentic AI portfolio projects; course completion should be backed by a deployed demo.
credentials.prerequisites: Basic Python and API familiarity are useful; review the current course prerequisites.
credentials.exam_details: Multiple course assessments and projects; not a proctored vendor certification exam.
credentials.research_notes: Official IBM badge description outlines RAG, vector stores, multimodal apps, and agent frameworks.

credentials.name: IBM AI Developer Professional Certificate
credentials.type: Course-based professional certificate — not a proctored vendor certification
credentials.about: Entry-level series on AI concepts, Python-based AI applications, chatbots, APIs, and building AI-powered software.

price.notes: Coursera price varies by country and offer.

credentials.usefulness: Accessible starting point for AI application engineering; use the projects as portfolio evidence.
credentials.prerequisites: No prior experience is required according to IBM's program description.
credentials.exam_details: Course quizzes, labs, and projects; not a single proctored certification exam.
credentials.research_notes: IBM official program description says it includes hands-on projects and an AI app development path.

credentials.name: OpenAI Academy course badges and pathway certificates
credentials.type: Free course-completion badge/certificate — explicitly not a professional certification
credentials.about: Free self-paced courses include AI Foundations, Applied AI Foundations, Agents and Workflows, and developer pathways covering evaluation, agentic systems, RAG, and performance optimization.

price.notes: OpenAI Academy says courses are free for people with a ChatGPT account.

credentials.level: Beginner to intermediate depending on pathway
credentials.usefulness: Good direct learning from OpenAI, especially for GenAI app, agents, RAG, and evaluation topics; it is a completion credential, not a vendor certification.
credentials.prerequisites: ChatGPT account; no workspace membership required.
credentials.exam_details: Complete each course and pass its assessment; eligible pathway certificates require completing all courses and assessments with at least 80%.
credentials.validity: No professional certification validity period stated.
credentials.research_notes: OpenAI Help Center explicitly says Academy badges and completion certificates are not certifications and do not guarantee eligibility for a future certification.

credentials.name: Hugging Face LLM Course certificate
credentials.type: Free course-completion certificate — not a professional certification
credentials.about: Self-paced learning on Transformers, pretrained models, fine-tuning, and sharing models; chapter quizzes provide course completion evidence.

price.notes: Price may vary by country, taxes, or checkout.

credentials.usefulness: Useful for learning the open-source model ecosystem and demonstrating completion; best paired with a Hugging Face model or fine-tuning project.
credentials.prerequisites: Basic Python and machine-learning concepts are helpful.
credentials.exam_details: Course chapter quiz; requirements vary by course section.
credentials.research_notes: Official Hugging Face course documentation includes an end-of-chapter certificate flow.

credentials.name: Hugging Face Agents Course certificate
credentials.type: Free course-completion certificate — not a professional certification
credentials.about: Learning path for building AI agents, with course units and a final quiz; covers agent concepts and practical agent-building tools.

price.notes: Price may vary by country, taxes, or checkout.

credentials.usefulness: A useful no-cost learning credential for agentic AI; build and publish an agent project to improve CV value.
credentials.prerequisites: Basic Python and LLM/API familiarity are useful.
credentials.exam_details: Complete Unit 1 and pass its final quiz at 80% or higher for the course certificate; check course page for current full-program requirements.
credentials.research_notes: Official Hugging Face course instructions describe certificate criteria.

credentials.name: Hugging Face Audio Course certificate
credentials.type: Free course-completion certificate — not a professional certification
credentials.about: Practical audio AI course with hands-on assignments and a completion/excellence certificate.

price.notes: Price may vary by country, taxes, or checkout.

credentials.usefulness: Relevant for speech and audio AI learners; hands-on model/demo submissions make the credential more meaningful.
credentials.prerequisites: Python and basic ML/audio knowledge recommended.
credentials.exam_details: Pass at least 3 of 4 hands-on assignments for completion; 4 of 4 for certificate of excellence.
credentials.research_notes: Official Hugging Face page explicitly says the certification process is free and lists assignment criteria.

credentials.name: AWS Generative AI for Developers Professional Certificate
credentials.type: Course-based professional certificate — not AWS Certification exam credential
credentials.about: Learning program for generative AI development using concepts and AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Q Developer, with hands-on labs.

price.notes: Coursera/edX pricing, promotions, and certificate access vary; this is separate from AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional.

credentials.usefulness: Structured preparation for AWS GenAI development; do not confuse this course certificate with the paid AWS professional certification exam.
credentials.prerequisites: Designed for students and early-to-mid-career software developers; programming fundamentals are helpful.
credentials.exam_details: Course modules and labs; no single AWS Certification proctored exam.
credentials.research_notes: Official AWS Training blog distinguishes the course-based Professional Certificate from AWS Certification exams.

credentials.name: NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute course certificates
credentials.type: Course completion certificate / certificate of competency, depending on course
credentials.about: Hands-on courses in deep learning, generative AI, accelerated computing, computer vision, and model deployment; certificate availability and pricing depend on course.

price.notes: Some self-paced courses are free; instructor-led workshops may be paid. Verify the individual course.

credentials.level: Beginner to advanced depending on course
credentials.usefulness: Good targeted evidence of practical skills when a relevant lab-based course is completed; not one universal NVIDIA certification.
credentials.prerequisites: Depends on course; some require basic Python/ML knowledge.
credentials.exam_details: Course-specific quizzes, labs, or instructor-led assessment.
credentials.validity: Depends on the specific course credential.
credentials.research_notes: Official NVIDIA training catalog; course credentials should not be mislabelled as NCA-AMAD certification.

credentials.name: Anthropic Claude training / public certification status
credentials.type: No public, generally available proctored professional certification verified in this research
credentials.about: Anthropic publishes Claude documentation and learning resources, but this batch did not identify an official public exam-based Claude certification comparable to AWS or Google certifications.

price.notes: Price may vary by country, taxes, or checkout.

credentials.usefulness: Avoid paying third parties for a credential presented as an official Anthropic certification unless Anthropic itself confirms it. Learn through official docs and show working Claude API projects instead.
credentials.prerequisites: Depends on the selected documentation/tutorial.
credentials.exam_details: No official public proctored certification exam confirmed in this research.
credentials.research_notes: Status note is limited to the official public resources reviewed; it is not a claim that no private/partner training exists.

research_notes: Credential types are explicitly separated: proctored vendor certifications, course-based professional certificates, and free completion badges/certificates are not interchangeable.
Microsoft AI-102 and AI-900 are excluded as active recommendations because official Microsoft pages list them as retired in 2026; AI-103 and AI-300 are listed as the newer role-aligned credentials.
AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer Associate is in a 2026 MLA-C02 beta period; the listed $75 is beta pricing, not a confirmed standard exam fee.
Prices may vary by country, tax, promotions, or checkout. Where a current price could not be verified, the field says so.
Anthropic is included as a status note because an official public exam-based Claude certification was not verified in the reviewed sources; this avoids inventing a credential.
Role mappings are relevance suggestions based on credential scope, not a guarantee of qualification or employment.
This is a curated research batch rather than an exhaustive list of every possible AI/ML credential.
